_doc: Cirra, on Flutter (cut 2026-11-25: song bars 30-49, 63-76, 128 BPM). Bars 0-7 the build, cold and windless; 4 the Kindling gives the wave; 7 Helion's moment; 8-19 the drop: the gust (8-11, 2x), the tight gusts (13-14, mini), the kite strings (15-19); 20 the lift; 21-33 the second high: Seo's kites (21-24, 2x), mini again (26-27); 33 the seal.
Every bar is charted by hand (presses.json). The id is the world's slot, not the song: saves, scenes and stars are kept under it.
title: Flutter
adds: The wave: each tap turns the zig-zag through the wind; mini in the tight gusts

setpieces.name: The Kindling's gift
setpieces.what: as the song's arpeggio comes in, Cirra's Kindling rises off the planet: the wave (each tap turns the zig-zag)

setpieces.name: Helion's moment
setpieces.what: his motif far off on the build's thin bar; his silhouette in the shadow ring

setpieces.name: The gust
setpieces.what: the drop: a gust carries you round Cirra at double speed (2x), wind spirals streaming round the planet, Seo's kites going up

setpieces.name: The tight gusts
setpieces.what: mini: Orbin small, quick low hops, quick doubles through two bars

setpieces.name: The kite strings
setpieces.what: lines of light strung across the sky; you weave the wave between them; a short hold

setpieces.name: Seo's kites
setpieces.what: the second high: the gust again (2x), Seo flying every kite, mini again at 48.8

setpieces.name: The seal
setpieces.what: the last wall is the Stillness's seal on the star; the last tap breaks it
